ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_200..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_200..original: Alchemy has brought positive change to the city. I want my taking the throne to be the same.
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_200..translation: Алхимия принесла городу позитивные перемены. Хочу, чтобы и моё вступление на трон было таким же.

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_200..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_200..original: Very well. If that's what you want, Mathias, we'll happily take this job!
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_200..translation: Хорошо. Если ты этого хочешь, Матиас — мы с радостью возьмёмся!

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_200..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_200..original: You said it! We'll make you a dazzling crown for your coronation!
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_200..translation: Сказано! Мы сделаем тебе ослепительную корону к коронации!

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_200..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_200..original: Thanks! No need to hold back, you can really go all out!
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_200..translation: Спасибо! Не сдерживайтесь — выкладывайтесь на полную!

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_210..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_210..original: OK. Let me take a look.

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_210..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_210..original: Yes. Good color, good sheen. This is a great crown!
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_210..translation: Да. Хороший цвет, хороший блеск. Отличная корона!

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_210..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_210..original: It stands up well compared to my dad's crown, too. In fact, it might be even better!
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_210..translation: И рядом с отцовской смотрится достойно. Пожалуй, даже лучше!

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_210..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_210..original: Great, glad to hear it. We were pretty nervous about such an important job.
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_210..translation: Отлично, рада слышать. Мы очень нервничали из-за такого важного дела.

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_210..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_210..original: Hehe. We put a lot of hard work and feelings into this.
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_210..translation: Хе-хе. Мы вложили в это много труда и чувств.

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_210..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_210..original: You keep it safe, Your Majesty! Keep it on your head!
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_210..translation: Берегите её, Ваше Величество! Держите на голове!

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_210..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_210..original: I will. I'll treasure this forever. Wow, this also means I really can't run away!
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_210..translation: Буду. Буду беречь её вечно. Ух... значит, бежать уже точно нельзя!

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_210..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_210..original: Come on, Mathias, you'll be fine! You're going to make a great king!
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_210..translation: Да ладно, Матиас, всё будет хорошо! Из тебя выйдет великий король!

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_210..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_210..original: Yes, you're right. It's just... ah, it's nothing.
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_210..translation: Да, вы правы. Просто... ах, ничего.

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_210..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_210..original: Heheh, here's your reward. Thank you, both of you!
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_210..translation: Хе-хе, вот ваша награда. Спасибо вам обеим!

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_210..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_210..original: Wow, thanks! I can't wait for the coronation!
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_210..translation: Вау, спасибо! Не могу дождаться коронации!

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_210..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_210..original: Hmm. Something still sounds a little off. Am I just imagining things?
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_210..translation: Хм. Что-то всё ещё звучит странно. Или мне кажется?

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_210..speaker: System
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_210..original: A new Combination Art for Sue and Mathias <CLEG>"Full-Power Gunplay"<CLNR> is unlocked.
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_210..translation: Разблокировано новое комбинированное искусство для Сью и Матиаса <CLEG>«Полная огневая мощь»<CLNR>.

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..original: Hey.
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..translation: Привет.

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..original: Ah, Your Majesty! Your Royal Highness!
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..translation: Ах, Ваше Величество! Ваше Королевское Высочество!

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..original: Please, come in!
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..translation: Пожалуйста, входите!

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..original: How many times do I have to say this? I'm not king yet! You're just making fun of me, aren't you?
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..translation: Сколько раз мне это говорить? Я ещё не король! Вы просто надо мной издеваетесь, да?

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..original: Of course! What's up, though? You look like you've got something on your mind?
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..translation: Конечно! А что случилось? У тебя такой вид, будто что-то на уме.

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..original: Come on, you can tell us anything. We'll help you however we can.
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..translation: Давай, можешь рассказать нам что угодно. Мы поможем, чем сможем.

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..original: Thanks for saying that. I do have something I want to ask you both.
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..translation: Спасибо, что так говорите. Мне и правда нужно вас обеих о чём-то попросить.

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..original: If the two of you had to live apart, starting from tomorrow, what would you say?
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..translation: Если бы вам двоим с завтрашнего дня пришлось жить раздельно — что бы вы сказали?

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..speaker: Together
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..original: No way!
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..translation: Ни за что!

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..speaker: System
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..original: No way!
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..translation: Ни за что!

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..original: Why?
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..translation: Почему?

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..original: We've lived together since we were born, and that's never going to change!
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..translation: Мы живём вместе с рождения — и так будет всегда!

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..original: That's right. The two of us are one. We couldn't possibly live apart!
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..translation: Верно. Мы двое — одно целое. Жить врозь невозможно!

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..original: Yes, you're right. I knew it!
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..translation: Да, вы правы. Я так и знал!

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..original: Sorry, girls, but can I ask you to do a job for me, too?
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..translation: Простите, девочки, но можно вас попросить ещё об одном деле?

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..original: That crown you made for me. Can you make another one?
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..translation: Ту корону, что вы сделали для меня. Можете сделать ещё одну?

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..original: What? Another crown? Not thinking of growing a second head, are you?
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..translation: Что? Ещё одну корону? Не собираешься отращивать вторую голову?

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..original: I can't tell you. I just really need one! Please!
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..translation: Не могу сказать. Мне просто очень нужна ещё одна! Пожалуйста!

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..original: OK! Anything for the future king!
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..translation: Хорошо! Всё для будущего короля!

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..original: We'll bring you another crown, just as great as the first one. Just wait a little while, Mathias!
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..translation: Мы принесём тебе ещё одну корону — не хуже первой. Подожди немного, Матиас!

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..original: Thanks. I know you can handle this, Lydie, Sue!
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_220..translation: Спасибо. Знаю, вы справитесь, Лиди, Сью!

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..original: Here you go, Mathias. The second crown you ordered.
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..translation: Вот, Матиас. Вторая корона, как ты просил.

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..original: This one is really well made, too. So now...
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..translation: Эта тоже отлично сделана. Значит, теперь...

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..original: How about you tell us why you need another one?
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..translation: Может, расскажешь, зачем тебе ещё одна?

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..original: Hehe, I'm the next king, after all. It's a little soon, but I'm going to use some of that power.
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..translation: Хе-хе, я же будущий король. Рановато, но кое-какой властью я уже воспользуюсь.

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..original: Girls, come with me. I want you to see this, too.
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..translation: Девочки, пойдёмте со мной. Хочу, чтобы вы тоже это увидели.

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..original: Mathias. And the twins, too. What's up?
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..translation: Матиас. И близнецы тоже. Что случилось?

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..original: Sister. Can you please clear the room?
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..translation: Сестра. Не могла бы ты освободить комнату?

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..original: What? I guess so.
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..translation: Что? Ну... хорошо.

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..original: I've done as you asked. What's up? You're acting a bit odd.
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..translation: Сделала, как ты просил. Что такое? Ты ведёшь себя странно.

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..original: Sis. You've always looked out for me, haven't you.
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..translation: Сестрёнка. Ты всегда обо мне заботилась, правда?

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..original: Supported me, from the shadows. I've only made it this far thanks to you.
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..translation: Поддерживала из тени. Я зашёл так далеко только благодаря тебе.

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..original: Mathias? What is this?
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..translation: Матиас? Что это?

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..original: That's why I need you to help me rule.
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..translation: Поэтому мне нужно, чтобы ты помогала мне править.

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..original: Just like Lydie and Sue and everything they can do, we're better off together!
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..translation: Как Лиди и Сью — вдвоём мы сильнее! Нам лучше вместе!

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..original: That's why I want you to take this.
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..translation: Поэтому я хочу, чтобы ты приняла это.

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..original: Hey, this is a crown! You're seriously going to tell me to rule, after all this?
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..translation: Эй, это корона! Ты серьёзно после всего этого говоришь мне править?

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..original: No! I'll be the king. I want you to be, well, the power behind the throne?
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..translation: Нет! Королём буду я. А тебя я хочу видеть... ну, силой за троном?

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..original: Sister. Please, will you continue to support me, even once I come to power?
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..translation: Сестра. Пожалуйста, продолжай поддерживать меня — даже когда я приду к власти?

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..original: I'm sure that's the best for the future of Adalet, too.
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..translation: Уверен, это лучше и для будущего Адалета.

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..original: Let me confirm one thing with you. You've given this a lot of careful thought, I take it?
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..translation: Уточню одно. Ты всё это тщательно обдумал, верно?

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..original: Yes. I think this is the best way forward.
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..translation: Да. Думаю, это лучший путь.

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..original: I see. I which case, it can't be helped. Looks like I'll be holding your hand forever, hah!
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..translation: Понятно. Тогда ничего не поделаешь. Похоже, мне вечно держать тебя за руку, ха!

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..original: King Mathias. I accept the role of, what are we calling this, the king in shadow?
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..translation: Король Матиас. Я принимаю роль... как мы это назовём — теневого короля?

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..original: A shadow must always be a shadow, however. You'll have to do all of your own duties properly. Understand?
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..translation: Но тень всегда должна оставаться тенью. Свои обязанности тебе придётся выполнять как следует. Понял?

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..original: Of course! Lydie, Sue, you're up!
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..translation: Конечно! Лиди, Сью — ваш выход!

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..original: We've going to hold a shadow coronation, right now! You two have to bear witness.
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..translation: Сейчас мы проведём теневую коронацию! Вы двое должны стать свидетелями.

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..original: We need you two to watch over us as we make a vow the world can never know about!
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..translation: Нам нужно, чтобы вы смотрели, как мы даём клятву, о которой мир никогда не узнает!

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..original: OK, we can do that. We won't blink once!
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..translation: Хорошо, справимся. Не моргнём ни разу!

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..original: Yes! We'll burn it into our memories!
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..translation: Да! Запечатлеем это в памяти!

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..original: OK. Here we go!
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..translation: Ладно. Начинаем!

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..original: This really brings it all home, doesn't it.
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..translation: Вот теперь всё по-настоящему ощущается, правда?

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..original: Hahaha, yeah. Being watched is a little embarrassing though...
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..translation: Ха-ха-ха, да. Хотя когда за тобой смотрят — немного неловко...

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..original: Uwah! That really suits you, both of you!
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..translation: Ува! Вам обоим очень идёт!

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..original: King Mathias! Queen Mireille! Lead our country into a better future!
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..translation: Король Матиас! Королева Мирей! Ведите нашу страну к лучшему будущему!

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..original: Yes! We promise to do so!
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..translation: Да! Обещаем!

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..original: Indeed we do. You first, Mathias.
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..translation: Именно так. Ты первый, Матиас.

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..original: As ruler, I promise to create a land in which all the people can live safe and happy lives.
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..translation: Как правитель клянусь создать землю, где все люди смогут жить в безопасности и счастье.

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..original: As ruler, I promise to create a land in which all the people can live safe and happy lives.
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..translation: Как правитель клянусь создать землю, где все люди смогут жить в безопасности и счастье.

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..original: In this moment, I, Mathias Ferrier Adalet, as the king...
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..translation: В сей час я, Матиас Феррье Адалет, как король...

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..original: In this moment, I, Mireille Ferrier Adalet, as the king in shadow...
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..translation: В сей час я, Мирей Феррье Адалет, как теневой король...

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..speaker: Together
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..original: Do swear to succeed the throne of this great land!
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..translation: Клянёмся наследовать трон этой великой страны!

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..speaker: System
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..original: Do swear to succeed the throne of this great land!
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..translation: Клянёмся наследовать трон этой великой страны!

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..original: Wow! We bore witness to something incredible, didn't we!
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..translation: Вау! Мы стали свидетелями чего-то невероятного!

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..original: Yeah! The scoop of the century! It's not like we can tell anyone about it, though.
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..translation: Ага! Сенсация века! Хотя никому рассказать нельзя.

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..original: That's the way it has to be, girls.
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..translation: Так и должно быть, девочки.

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..speaker: Mireille
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..original: There have never been two people wearing the crown. You understand too, Mathias?
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..translation: Никогда не было двоих в короне. Ты тоже понимаешь, Матиас?

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..original: Haha, of course I do. I do, but...
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..translation: Ха-ха, конечно. Понимаю, но...

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..original: It's a minor problem, really, compared to what it will do for our nation.
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_230..translation: По сравнению с тем, что это даст стране, это мелочь.

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_240..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_240..original: Hey, the king is slacking off!

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_240..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_240..original: We need to include this in our report to the king in shadow!
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_240..translation: Надо включить это в отчёт теневому королю!

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_240..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_240..original: Hey, don't. Don't do that! I'll be stripped of the position in an instant!
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_240..translation: Эй, не надо! Не делайте этого! Меня мигом лишат должности!

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_240..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_240..original: Hahaha, we were just joking. Kind of!
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_240..translation: Ха-ха-ха, мы просто пошутили. Ну, почти!

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_240..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_240..original: Sue's right. If you don't keep it together as king, we'll be letting Mireille know!
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_240..translation: Сью права. Если не будешь держаться как король — мы сообщим Мирей!

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_240..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_240..original: This is odd. I'm starting to feel like I've walked myself into even more trouble!
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_240..translation: Странно... Кажется, я сам себе нажил ещё больше хлопот!

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_240..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_240..original: I can't fool you, can I. No, I made this decision. I'm not going to start regretting it now.
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_240..translation: Вас не проведёшь, да? Нет, я принял это решение. Жалеть не собираюсь.

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_240..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_240..original: Looking back, I guess this all turned out because of you two.
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_240..translation: Оглядываясь назад — всё это вышло благодаря вам двоим.

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_240..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_240..original: Seeing you work together so hard, I have to admit, it's pretty inspiring. I like it.
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_240..translation: Видеть, как вы так усердно работаете вместе, должен признать — это вдохновляет. Мне нравится.

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_240..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_240..original: Hehe, just you wait and see. Me and my sister are going to make this country even greater!
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_240..translation: Хе-хе, вот увидите. Мы с сестрой сделаем эту страну ещё лучше!

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_240..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_240..original: Yeah, I can't wait! Just make sure you never look unemployed again, OK?
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_240..translation: Да, не могу дождаться! Только больше не выгляди безработным, ладно?

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_240..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_240..original: Uwah! You dare speak to your monarch like that? Off with her head!
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_240..translation: Ува! Ты смеешь так говорить со своим монархом? Отрубить ей голову!

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_240..speaker: Sue
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_240..original: Such abuse of power! The only thing I want to see you cutting are our taxes, king creep!
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_240..translation: Злоупотребление властью! Единственное, что я хочу видеть урезанным — наши налоги, король-пройдоха!

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_240..speaker: Mathias
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_240..original: Hey, I'm no creep! Right, for that, I'm going to double your taxes!
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_240..translation: Эй, я не пройдоха! За это удваиваю тебе налоги!

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_240..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_240..original: Hahaha! I think the country is going to be a lot of fun with you in charge, Mathias.
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_240..translation: Ха-ха-ха! Думаю, с тобой во главе стране будет очень весело, Матиас.

ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_240..speaker: Lydie
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_240..original: We really are looking forward to everything you'll do!
ebm:qc04_mat/event_message_qc04_mat_240..translation: Мы очень ждём всего, что ты сделаешь!
